title: AC1021 TABLE General value output generated control
reconciliationNotice: Historical evidence for the proposed PR-branch writer only. The combined candidate keeps General-value output refused because the independent ODA comparison in p5-ac1021-general-value-oda-dxf-comparison-2026-11-25.json differs and the payload semantics remain unproven. The former success-test registration is not present in the combined candidate.
scope: Implement a fail-closed ASCII/Binary DXF transport for the bounded AC1021 TABLE General CadValue envelope identified by the P5-I source trace. This checks raw carrier output only; it does not establish General value meaning or whole-table support.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
rulesApplied: The TABLE cell value is emitted as a CELL_VALUE envelope.
CadValue type 512 is retained as a bounded byte payload with its declared byte count, units, format and display cache.
The payload remains opaque; no semantic interpretation or completeness promotion is made.

generatedControl.sourceDisposition: Both payload byte arrays are authored locally from scratch. The 48- and 52-byte lengths and labels match the selected P5-I cells, but these generated bytes are not copied from the AutoCAD DWG and are not producer evidence.
checks: Strict ASCII and Binary output for both generated payload lengths.
Independent scalar wire walker verifies the exact group-code sequence and raw bytes.
Fresh libdxfrw readback verifies the raw byte vector, declared size, cache and metadata; semanticContentComplete remains false.
AC1024, mismatched raw bytes and unsupported flags are refused without replacing the destination; corrected same-writer retries succeed.

sourcePayloadProjection.sourceProfile: AC1021 AutoCAD 2007 sample; two TABLE records selected by the existing source-bound cell trace
sourcePayloadProjection.projection: Each selected source cell was copied into a locally constructed one-cell TABLE with a closed modelspace owner. The source ACAD_TABLESTYLE dictionary and typed style bodies were included, but all source TABLESTYLE reactor edges were removed because the output does not contain full source TABLE snapshots. This is a lossy style projection and does not qualify source appearance or graph closure.
checks: Strict AC1021 ASCII and Binary output accepted each selected source payload in the bounded carrier.
The emitted ASCII group-310 bytes independently extracted from the output equal the source payload lengths and SHA-256 values listed above.
Fresh libdxfrw readback preserved the text and raw payload for both encodings; semanticContentComplete remained false.

results.peerObservations: One TABLE, one row and one column; General value type, flags 6, NoUnits, empty format, formatted value matches; linked Schedule style resolves with horizontal/vertical margins 1/0.4.
One TABLE, one row and one column; General value type, flags 6, NoUnits, empty format, formatted value matches; linked Schedule style resolves with horizontal/vertical margins 1/0.4.

limits: ACadSharp leaves CadValue.Value empty for these type-512 carriers and does not expose or verify the group-310 raw payload; it confirms the separately emitted formatted-value cache and other typed envelope fields only.
The peer readback covers the one-cell projections with TABLESTYLE reactor links stripped; it does not establish the original source reactor graph, full TABLE semantics, or native rendering.

libreDwgPeerAttempt.observation: LibreDWG reports unknown TABLE codes, errors on row/column counts and CELL_VALUE fields, and reports TABLESTYLE and TABLE unsupported; its conversion output is not a semantic readback.

sourceTableStyleDependencyProbe.probe: A strict-output projection with the source style dictionary and both source TABLE handles represented by one-cell subsets was refused during extension-object graph validation. A follow-up carrier-only experiment passed after removing the source TABLESTYLE reactor edges; this mutation is explicitly lossy and is not evidence of source-style or whole-table support.

limits: ACadSharp independently read back the TABLE envelope and formatted cache only; it did not decode the raw General payload bytes. No native CAD open/render was run.

The one-cell projections include the source style dictionary/body but strip source TABLESTYLE reactors and omit merge and unrelated table graph state; they do not qualify source-table appearance or whole-table semantics.
P5-B FIELD/FIELDLIST output remains a blocker for whole-source conversion.
No fixture was added and no support claim is promoted.
